title: Account
admin_body: Users, shortlinks, audit logs and moderation.
pw_body_change: Changing it signs you out everywhere else.
pw_body_set: You sign in with emailed codes. Add a password to log in without waiting for an email.
reauth_password: For your security, sign in again with an email code, then set your password here.
pw_changed: Password changed. Other sessions were signed out.
pw_set: Password set. You can now log in with it.
dl_title: Get a copy of your data
dl_body: We email you a JSON file with your account, short links, bio pages, forms and their responses, connected apps and saved palettes. It leaves out passwords, tokens and your visitors’ IP addresses. It can take a few minutes to arrive.
reauth_download: For your security, sign in again with an email code, then ask for your data here.
dl_rate: Too many requests. Please try again in an hour.
dl_failed: We could not queue your request. Please try again.
del_body: Your links, bio pages, forms, responses and uploaded files go offline now and are permanently deleted after 30 days. Signing in again before then cancels the deletion.
reauth_delete: For your security, sign in again with an email code, then delete your account here.
apps_body: AI apps you allowed to work with your account. Connector URL:
disconnect_body: {{name}} will lose access on its next request.
dl_sent: Done. Your data is on its way to your email; it can take a few minutes.
